threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still take a cab when it rains instead of just popping into the nearest pub for a pint and waiting it out.
Riding the 333 last night, the driver stopped mid-route for a spontaneous sing-along with a group of students. Brixton's nights never fail to surprise.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a toddler on a scooter, expertly weaving through a crowd outside Café Savigny while the street musicians played a melancholic tune.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can see a hipster on a bike juggling while waiting for the tram. Only in Kreuzberg would that be a daily commute spectacle.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local when they skip the BART to Civic Center and know the quickest bus route instead, even if it’s the most delayed one.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 49 this morning, and a guy was singing ‘I’m Still Standing’—talk about a soundtrack for a crowded commute. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always think Gràcia is just about Gaudí. But the real charm lies in hidden plazas where locals sip vermut and chat, far from the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewildered expressions while trying to decode the metro map at Fontana station.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the bus will be on time after the Tube strike news. Welcome to the chaos – it’s a whole new level of London life.
Last night on the 35, a guy offered his sandwich to two pigeons at Brixton station. They weren’t having it, just stared him down. Classic London moment.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a guy casually repairing a bike while grilling sausages on the sidewalk—it hit me, this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg does your lunch option come with a side of spontaneous street music from the skate park at Görlitzer Bahnhof. It’s like a live soundtrack!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're locals when they know which BART entrance to avoid during delays—always the one near the taco stand. Classic move.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: The Civic Center station's been a circus lately—first the smoke scare, now a dog taking a leisurely stroll on the tracks. Classic SF chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is all about the plaça, but the real charm is in the winding streets where old folks still sit outside to chat.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their fascination with the ‘teatre’ when it's just a regular playhouse. Locals know it’s a hub for things like improv nights.
